import pandas as pd

       AVG(hsaq.no2) as avg_no2,

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query average NO2 and PM2.5 for roadside stations during rush hours (08:00-09:00, 17:00-19:00) and off-peak hours (00:00-05:00, 10:00-15:00)
query = text("""
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) IN (8, 9, 17, 18, 19) THEN 'rush'
        WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) IN (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15) THEN 'offpeak'
        ELSE 'other'
    END as time_period,
    AVG(hsaq.no2) as avg_no2,
    AVG(hsaq.pm2_5) as avg_pm25
FROM hourly_station_air_quality hsaq
JOIN air_quality_station aqs ON hsaq.station_id = aqs.id
WHERE aqs.station_type = 'ROADSIDE'
  AND hsaq.datetime >= '2025-10-01 00:00:00' 
  AND hsaq.datetime < '2025-11-01 00:00:00'
  AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hsaq.datetime) IN (0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 17, 18, 19)
GROUP BY time_period
""")
result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(result)

# Calculate NO2/PM2.5 ratios
rush_no2_pm25_ratio = round(69.972826 / 18.106508, 2)
offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio = round(52.896282 / 17.356922, 2)

print(f"Rush hour NO2/PM2.5 ratio: {rush_no2_pm25_ratio}")
print(f"Off-peak NO2/PM2.5 ratio: {offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio}")

# Store results in variables
rush_no2_pm25_ratio = rush_no2_pm25_ratio
offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio = offpeak_no2_pm25_ratio
